en:
For players found by targeted signing,
set what they are called in matches.

Choose and confirm what this player is
called. It can't be changed while they
are at the club, so choose carefully.

Some players still don't have a squad
number. Please decide their numbers.

Choose a player to give a number to.
Press the B Button when you're done.
Anyone left out is numbered for you.

Players who don't have a number yet
will be assigned one for them.
Is that all right?

Each player's squad number is now set.
That completes squad number setup.

Which squad number will you give?
A number can't be changed while the
player is at the club, so be careful.

All players have been given numbers.
They can't be changed during a player's
time at the club. Happy to finish?
